claim: A pace-clock reading from game code must be made with interrupts off (or redone if one came in), the window must open with interrupts off, and the game's own waits must use the pace clock.

evidence.text: Main-line readings commit with interrupts off and read again if an interrupt came; the window opens with interrupts off; 14 real-time waits on the handler were hooked; 18 of 18 mutants rejected.
